claim: RETFound converges earlier and overfits the source pool more than ImageNet-MAE under the shared budget.
allowed_wording: Under the shared fixed budget RETFound reached its best source-validation QWK roughly twice as early and early-stopped in every run, while ImageNet-MAE never early-stopped; RETFound's source-validation loss rose further above its minimum. Reported as mechanistic context.
forbidden_wording: Overfitting causes the interaction. | RETFound is more prone to overfitting in general. | The budget disadvantaged RETFound.

claim: IDRiD contributes no full fine-tuning evidence; the interaction is estimated on two domains only.
